from robot import tools, handoff, query
from ora_lib import current, offset
from blocks import measure_block

obs = current()
print("start", obs.observation_id, "step", obs.step)
before = measure_block("blue", obs=obs, verbose=True)
if before is None:
    handoff("blue block not grounded")
print("blue before:", before)

gp = tools.grasp_plan(arm="right", target_ref=before["target_ref"], max_candidates=2)
cands = gp["result"]["candidates"]
if not cands:
    handoff("no grasp candidate for blue")
c0 = cands[0]
print("chosen grasp", c0["candidate_id"], "opening", c0["gripper_opening_m"],
      "contact", c0["contact_pose"], "ik", json.dumps(c0.get("ik_reachability"))[:300])

ge = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=c0["candidate_id"],
    rationale="top-down grasp across the ends of the blue T crossbar, vertical approach, jaw line along crossbar")
print("grasp_execute status", ge.status, "ok", ge.ok, "failure", ge.failure_code)
res = ge["result"]
print("stages", json.dumps(res.get("stages"), default=str)[:2500])
print("verification", json.dumps(res.get("verification"), default=str)[:1200])
if not ge.ok:
    handoff("grasp_execute failed", status=ge.status, failure=ge.failure_code,
            stages=res.get("stages"), summary=ge.summary)

after = measure_block("blue", verbose=True)
print("blue after grasp:", after)
tcp = current().pose("right").position
print("right link6 now", tcp.xyz.tolist(), "measured opening",
      current().robot_facts["end_effectors"]["right"]["gripper"]["measured_opening_normalized"])

# lift to a staging pose on the right arm's own side, keeping the grasp orientation
home = np.array([0.3004709482192993, -0.35229986906051636, 0.921500027179718])
hold = np.array([tcp.x, tcp.y, tcp.z]) + np.array([-0.045, 0.055, 0.10])
q = c0["contact_pose"]["orientation_xyzw"]
r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(x) for x in hold],
                                      "orientation_mode": "absolute_quaternion",
                                      "orientation_xyzw": q, "interaction": "free_space"}},
                    speed="normal")
print("hold move", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, "err", r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("hold move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)

held = measure_block("blue", verbose=True)

import numpy as np
from robot import tools
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry
from ora_lib import geometry as G

def measure_block(color, text=None, camera="head", obs=None, verbose=False):
    """Ground a block and return world-frame footprint centroid, heading yaw, top-z."""
    obs = obs or current()
    cam = obs.camera(camera)
    r = tools.vision_ground(camera=camera, text=text or f"{color} T-shaped block")
    cands = r["result"]["candidates"]
    if not cands:
        return None
    best = None
    for c in cands:
        tgt = obs.target(c["target_ref"])
        mask = np.asarray(tgt.mask).astype(bool)
        n = int(mask.sum())
        if best is None or n > best[0]:
            best = (n, c, mask)
    n, c, mask = best
    depth = np.asarray(cam.depth_m)
    K = np.asarray(cam.K)
    c2w = np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world)
    pts = np.asarray(G.mask_to_cloud(depth, K, mask)).reshape(-1, 3)
    pw = G.transform_points(pts, c2w)
    ztop = float(np.percentile(pw[:, 2], 97))
    top = pw[pw[:, 2] > ztop - 0.002]
    cen = top[:, :2].mean(axis=0)
    d = top[:, :2] - cen
    cov = d.T @ d / len(d)
    w, v = np.linalg.eigh(cov)
    u = v[:, np.argmax(w)]
    if u[1] < 0:
        u = -u
    perp = np.array([-u[1], u[0]])
    s = d @ u
    t = d @ perp
    bins = np.linspace(s.min(), s.max(), 9)
    prof = []
    for i in range(len(bins) - 1):
        m = (s >= bins[i]) & (s < bins[i + 1])
        if m.sum() >= 3:
            prof.append((0.5 * (bins[i] + bins[i + 1]), float(np.abs(t[m]).max())))
    s_cb = max(prof, key=lambda p: p[1])[0]
    heading = u if s_cb < 0 else -u
    out = dict(centroid_xy=[float(x) for x in cen], heading=[float(x) for x in heading],
               yaw_deg=float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(heading[1], heading[0]))),
               top_z=ztop, top_z_std=float(top[:, 2].std()), npix=n, n_top=int(len(top)),
               centroid_z=float(pw[:, 2].mean()), target_ref=c["target_ref"],
               bbox=c.get("bbox_xyxy"))
    if verbose:
        print("  measure", color, out)
        print("  profile", [(round(a, 4), round(b, 4)) for a, b in prof])
    return out

gq = tools.geometry_query(camera="head", world_points_m=cand_pts)
for p, w in zip(cand_pts, gq["result"]["world_points"]):
    print("surface?", p, {k: w.get(k) for k in ("in_frame", "pixel_uv", "scene_depth_m", "depth_residual_m")})

# --- 2. move right arm (holding blue) to a clear hold pose on its own side ---
home_r = np.array(obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"]["right"]["pose_xyz_xyzw"][:3]) if False else np.array([0.3004709482192993, -0.35229986906051636, 0.921500027179718])
hold = home_r + np.array([-0.04, 0.05, 0.12])
q_hold = obs.pose("right").rotation.as_quat() if hasattr(obs.pose("right").rotation, "as_quat") else None
q_now = np.array(obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"]["right"]["pose_xyz_xyzw"][3:])
rc = query("reach_check", arm="right", poses=[list(hold) + list(q_now)], interaction="freight") if False else query("reach_check", arm="right", poses=[list(hold) + list(q_now)], interaction="free_space")
print("hold reach:", hold, rc.get("results"))
if not rc["results"][0].get("reachable"):
    handoff("hold pose unreachable", hold=hold.tolist(), res=rc.get("results"))
r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(x) for x in hold],
                                      "orientation_mode": "hold_current", "interaction": "free_space"}}, speed="normal")
print("move to hold:", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("hold move failed", r.status, r.failure_code)
print("right link6 now", current().pose("right").position.xyz.tolist())

# --- 3. left arm picks red ---
red = measure_block("red", verbose=True)

    handoff("red not grounded")
gp = tools.grasp_plan(arm="left", target_ref=red["target_ref"], max_candidates=2)
cands = gp["result"]["candidates"]
print("red grasp candidates:", [(c["candidate_id"], round(c["gripper_opening_m"], 4), c["contact_pose"]["position_m"],
                                 (c.get("ik_reachability") or {}).get("reachable")) for c in cands])
if not cands:
    handoff("no red grasp candidate")
c0 = cands[0]
ge = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=c0["candidate_id"],
    rationale="top-down grasp across the ends of the red T crossbar with the left arm, vertical approach")
print("grasp red:", ge.status, ge.ok, ge.failure_code)
print("stages:", [(s.get("stage"), s.get("status")) for s in ge["result"].get("stages", [])])
print("verif:", json.dumps(ge["result"].get("verification"), default=str)[:400])
if not ge.ok:
    handoff("red grasp failed", ge.status, ge.failure_code, ge["result"].get("stages"))

held = measure_block("red", verbose=True)
p1 = np.array(current().pose("left").position.xyz)
print("red held:", held, "left link6", p1.tolist())
if held is None or held["top_z"] < 0.83:
    handoff("red not lifted", held=held)
json.dump({"red_before": red, "red_held": held, "cand": c0, "link6": p1.tolist()},
          open("/work/state_red_held.json", "w"), indent=2)

# --- 4. transit over temp spot (keep orientation) ---
temp = np.array([-0.02, -0.32])
o_world = np.array(held["centroid_xy"]) - p1[:2]           # block centroid minus link6, world xy
dz_top = p1[2] - held["top_z"]                              # link6 above block top face
target_z = 0.7805 + dz_top + 0.07                            # block top 7 cm above rest height
link6_goal = np.array([temp[0] - o_world[0], temp[1] - o_world[1], target_z])
print("transit link6", link6_goal.tolist(), "o_world", o_world.tolist(), "dz_top", dz_top)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={"left": {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(x) for x in link6_goal],
                                      "orientation_mode": "hold_current", "interaction": "free_space"}}, speed="normal")
print("transit:", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("transit failed", r.status, r.failure_code)
now = measure_block("red", verbose=True)
p2 = np.array(current().pose("left").position.xyz)
print("red at transit:", now, "link6", p2.tolist())
json.dump({"red_transit": now, "link6_transit": p2.tolist(), "o_world": o_world.tolist(), "dz_top": dz_top},
          open("/work/state_red_transit.json", "w"), indent=2)
miss = float(np.hypot(now["centroid_xy"][0] - temp[0], now["centroid_xy"][1] - temp[1])) if now else None
print("xy miss vs temp:", miss)

import numpy as np

def ransac_plane(P, band=0.0006, iters=400, seed=0):
    P = np.asarray(P, float)
    if len(P) < 20:
        return None
    rs = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    best = (-1, None)
    for _ in range(iters):
        i = rs.choice(len(P), 3, replace=False)
        a, b, c = P[i]
        n = np.cross(b - a, c - a)
        nn = np.linalg.norm(n)
        if nn < 1e-9:
            continue
        n = n / nn
        d = n @ a
        inl = np.abs(P @ n - d) < band
        cnt = int(inl.sum())
        if cnt > best[0]:
            best = (cnt, (n, d, inl))
    if best[1] is None:
        return None
    n, d, inl = best[1]
    Q = P[inl]
    cen = Q.mean(axis=0)
    u, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(Q - cen, full_matrices=False)
    n2 = vt[2]
    if n2 @ n < 0:
        n2 = -n2
    if n2[2] < 0:
        n2 = -n2
    res = (Q - cen) @ n2
    return dict(normal=n2, centroid=cen, n_inl=int(len(Q)), frac=len(Q) / len(P),
                resid_std=float(res.std()), tilt_deg=float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(n2[2], -1, 1)))),
                axes=vt)

def t_heading_in_plane(P, nrm):
    cen = P.mean(axis=0)
    u, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(P - cen, full_matrices=False)
    e1 = vt[0] - (vt[0] @ nrm) * nrm
    e1 = e1 / np.linalg.norm(e1)
    e2 = np.cross(nrm, e1)
    t1 = (P - cen) @ e1
    t2 = (P - cen) @ e2
    cov = np.cov(np.vstack([t1, t2]))
    w, v = np.linalg.eigh(cov)
    ax = v[:, np.argmax(w)]
    longdir = ax[0] * e1 + ax[1] * e2
    if longdir[1] < 0:
        longdir = -longdir
    s1 = (P - cen) @ longdir
    perp = np.cross(nrm, longdir)
    tt = (P - cen) @ perp
    bins = np.linspace(s1.min(), s1.max(), 8)
    prof = []
    for i in range(len(bins) - 1):
        mm = (s1 >= bins[i]) & (s1 < bins[i + 1])
        if mm.sum() >= 8:
            prof.append((0.5 * (bins[i] + bins[i + 1]), float(np.abs(tt[mm]).max())))
    s_cb = max(prof, key=lambda p: p[1])[0] if prof else 0.0
    heading = longdir if s_cb < 0 else -longdir
    return dict(centroid=[float(x) for x in cen], heading=[float(x) for x in heading],
                yaw_deg=float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(heading[1], heading[0]))),
                extent_long=float(s1.max() - s1.min()), extent_perp=float(tt.max() - tt.min()),
                prof=[[round(a, 4), round(b, 4)] for a, b in prof], n=int(len(P)))

import numpy as np
from skimage import measure
from ora_lib import geometry as G
from colorseg import color_mask
from planefit import ransac_plane, t_heading_in_plane

def held_block(obs, camera, color, arm, band=0.0008):
    cam = obs.camera(camera)
    m = color_mask(cam.rgb, color)
    lab = measure.label(m)
    if lab.max() == 0:
        return None
    props = sorted(measure.regionprops(lab), key=lambda p: -p.area)
    l6 = np.array(obs.pose(arm).position.xyz)
    depth = np.asarray(cam.depth_m); K = np.asarray(cam.K); c2w = np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world)
    for p in props[:3]:
        if p.area < 200:
            continue
        mask = lab == p.label
        pc = np.asarray(G.mask_to_cloud(depth, K, mask)).reshape(-1, 3)
        if len(pc) < 100:
            continue
        pw = G.transform_points(pc, c2w)
        r = np.hypot(pw[:, 0] - l6[0], pw[:, 1] - l6[1])
        g = (pw[:, 2] > l6[2] - 0.22) & (pw[:, 2] < l6[2] - 0.08) & (r < 0.10)
        P = pw[g]
        if len(P) < 200:
            continue
        rs = np.random.default_rng(0)
        S = P[rs.choice(len(P), min(len(P), 6000), replace=False)]
        pl = ransac_plane(S, band=band, iters=600)
        if pl is None:
            continue
        # refit on full cloud inliers of that plane
        n = pl["normal"]; d = n @ pl["centroid"]
        inl = np.abs(P @ n - d) < band
        Q = P[inl]
        hp = t_heading_in_plane(Q, n)
        return dict(camera=camera, color=color, arm=arm, n=int(len(P)), n_inl=int(len(Q)),
                    frac=float(len(Q) / len(P)), tilt_deg=pl["tilt_deg"], normal=[float(x) for x in pl["normal"]],
                    resid_std_mm=pl["resid_std"] * 1000.0, link6=[float(x) for x in l6],
                    top_centroid=hp["centroid"], yaw_deg=hp["yaw_deg"], heading=hp["heading"],
                    extent_long=hp["extent_long"], extent_perp=hp["extent_perp"], prof=hp["prof"],
                    offset_xy=[float(hp["centroid"][0] - l6[0]), float(hp["centroid"][1] - l6[1])],
                    dz=float(l6[2] - hp["centroid"][2]))
    return None

from robot import tools, handoff, query
from ora_lib import current
from blocks import table_block
from heldgeom import held_block
from planlib import Rz, wrap_deg
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

np.set_printoptions(precision=5, suppress=True)
obs = current()
refs = json.load(open("/work/reset_ref.json"))
red_reset = np.array([refs["red"]["top_centroid_xy"][0], refs["red"]["top_centroid_xy"][1], 0.7805])
print("start", obs.observation_id, "step", obs.step)

red_now = table_block(obs, "head", "red")
print("red on table:", json.dumps(red_now, default=str))
if red_now is None:
    handoff("red not found on table")
json.dump(red_now, open("/work/red_temp.json", "w"), indent=2)

bl = held_block(obs, "right_wrist", "blue", "right")
T0 = np.array(bl["top_centroid"]); p0 = np.array(bl["link6"])
R0 = Rotation.from_quat(np.array(obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"]["right"]["pose_xyz_xyzw"][3:]))
o_local = R0.inv().apply(T0 - p0)
d = wrap_deg(refs["red"]["yaw_deg"] - bl["yaw_deg"])
R1 = Rz(d) * R0
goal = red_reset
print("o_local", o_local, "delta", d, "held yaw", bl["yaw_deg"], "tilt", bl["tilt_deg"])

def mov(p, q, inter="free_space", speed="normal"):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(x) for x in p],
                                          "orientation_mode": "absolute_quaternion",
                                          "orientation_xyzw": [float(x) for x in q], "interaction": inter}},
                        speed=speed)
    print("  move", np.round(p, 4).tolist(), r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
    return r

transit = goal - R1.apply(o_local) + np.array([0, 0, 0.06])
if not mov(transit, R1.as_quat()).ok:
    handoff("transit failed")
bl2 = held_block(current(), "right_wrist", "blue", "right")
p_now = np.array(current().pose("right").position.xyz)
R1n = Rotation.from_quat(np.array(current().robot_facts["end_effectors"]["right"]["pose_xyz_xyzw"][3:]))
print("after transit: yaw", bl2["yaw_deg"], "tilt", bl2["tilt_deg"], "centroid", bl2["top_centroid"], "link6", p_now.tolist())
o_local = R1n.inv().apply(np.array(bl2["top_centroid"]) - p_now)
print("o_local now", o_local, "extent", bl2["extent_long"], bl2["extent_perp"])
dyaw = wrap_deg(refs["red"]["yaw_deg"] - bl2["yaw_deg"])
if abs(dyaw) > 1.0:
    R1n2 = Rz(dyaw) * R1n
    p_corr = p_now + (np.array(bl2["top_centroid"]) - R1n2.apply(o_local) + np.array([0, 0, 0.0])) - np.array(bl2["top_centroid"])
    print("yaw correction deg", dyaw, "to", p_corr.tolist())
    if not mov(p_corr, R1n2.as_quat(), inter="precision", speed="careful").ok:
        handoff("yaw correction failed")
    R1n = R1n2
    bl2 = held_block(current(), "right_wrist", "blue", "right")
    p_now = np.array(current().pose("right").position.xyz)
    o_local = R1n.inv().apply(np.array(bl2["top_centroid"]) - p_now)
    print("after yaw corr: yaw", bl2["yaw_deg"], "o_local", o_local)

desc = np.array(goal) - R1n.apply(o_local)
print("descend target", desc.tolist())
rc = query("reach_check", arm="right", poses=[list(desc) + list(R1n.as_quat())], interaction="precision")
print("reach descend:", rc.get("results"))
if not rc["results"][0].get("reachable"):
    handoff("descend unreachable", res=rc.get("results"), desc=desc.tolist())
if not mov(desc, R1n.as_quat(), inter="precision", speed="careful").ok:
    handoff("descend failed")
bl3 = held_block(current(), "right_wrist", "blue", "right")
print("at descend: top_z", bl3["top_centroid"][2] if bl3 else None, "tilt", bl3["tilt_deg"] if bl3 else None)
zoff = (bl3["top_centroid"][2] if bl3 else 0) - 0.7805
if bl3 is not None and zoff > 0.002:
    p_now = np.array(current().pose("right").position.xyz)
    print("extra descent", zoff - 0.001)
    if not mov(p_now + np.array([0, 0, -(zoff - 0.001)]), R1n.as_quat(), inter="precision", speed="careful").ok:
        handoff("second descent failed")
    bl3 = held_block(current(), "right_wrist", "blue", "right")
    print("after extra: top_z", bl3["top_centroid"][2] if bl3 else None)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={"right": "open"})
print("open right:", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": {"position_mode": "delta", "translation_m": [0.0, 0.0, 0.09],
                                      "position_frame": "world", "orientation_mode": "hold_current",
                                      "interaction": "free_space"}}, speed="normal")
print("retreat:", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code)
bl_final = held_block(current(), "right_wrist", "blue", "right")
print("blue after release (wrist):", json.dumps(bl_final, default=str))
json.dump({"blue_final_wrist": bl_final, "goal": goal.tolist(), "descend": desc.tolist(), "red_temp": red_now},
          open("/work/state_blue_placed.json", "w"), indent=2)

def table_block(obs, camera, color, zlo=0.7725, zhi=0.795, xy_center=None, radius=0.13):
    """Block lying on the table: colour mask gated to the top-face height band."""
    from colorseg import color_mask
    from planefit import ransac_plane, t_heading_in_plane
    cam = obs.camera(camera)
    m = color_mask(cam.rgb, color)
    depth = np.asarray(cam.depth_m); K = np.asarray(cam.K); c2w = np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world)
    pc = np.asarray(G.mask_to_cloud(depth, K, m)).reshape(-1, 3)
    if len(pc) < 50:
        return None
    pw = G.transform_points(pc, c2w)
    g = (pw[:, 2] > zlo) & (pw[:, 2] < zhi)
    if xy_center is not None:
        g &= np.hypot(pw[:, 0] - xy_center[0], pw[:, 1] - xy_center[1]) < radius
    P = pw[g]
    if len(P) < 60:
        return None
    rs = np.random.default_rng(0)
    S = P[rs.choice(len(P), min(len(P), 4000), replace=False)]
    pl = ransac_plane(S, band=0.0007, iters=500)
    if pl is None:
        return None
    n = pl["normal"]; dd = n @ pl["centroid"]
    inl = np.abs(P @ n - dd) < 0.0009
    Q = P[inl]
    if len(Q) < 50:
        return None
    hp = t_heading_in_plane(Q, n)
    return dict(camera=camera, color=color, n=int(len(P)), n_inl=int(len(Q)),
                tilt_deg=float(pl["tilt_deg"]), normal=[float(x) for x in n],
                centroid=hp["centroid"], yaw_deg=hp["yaw_deg"], heading=hp["heading"],
                extent_long=hp["extent_long"], extent_perp=hp["extent_perp"],
                top_z=float(hp["centroid"][2]), prof=hp["prof"])

# ground red, choose the candidate nearest the known temp position
res = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="red T-shaped block")
cam = obs.camera("head")
best = None
for c in res["result"]["candidates"]:
    tgt = obs.target(c["target_ref"])
    mask = np.asarray(tgt.mask).astype(bool)
    pc = np.asarray(G.mask_to_cloud(np.asarray(cam.depth_m), np.asarray(cam.K), mask)).reshape(-1, 3)
    pw = G.transform_points(pc, np.asarray(cam.camera_to_world))
    d = float(np.hypot(pw[:, 0].mean() - exp[0], pw[:, 1].mean() - exp[1]))
    zt = float(np.percentile(pw[:, 2], 97))
    print("  cand", c["candidate_id"], c["bbox_xyxy"], "score", round(c["backend_score"], 3),
          "centroid", np.round([pw[:, 0].mean(), pw[:, 1].mean()], 4).tolist(), "dist", round(d, 4), "topz", round(zt, 4))
    if d < 0.04 and 0.77 < zt < 0.79:
        if best is None or d < best[0]:
            best = (d, c)
if best is None:
    handoff("red target not matched near temp", exp=exp.tolist())
print("chosen", best[1]["candidate_id"], "dist", best[0])

gp = tools.grasp_plan(arm="right", target_ref=best[1]["target_ref"], max_candidates=2)
cands = gp["result"]["candidates"]
if not cands:
    handoff("no grasp candidate for red at temp", explain=gp.summary)
c0 = cands[0]
print("grasp cand", c0["candidate_id"], "opening", round(c0["gripper_opening_m"], 4),
      "contact", c0["contact_pose"], "ik", (c0.get("ik_reachability") or {}).get("reachable"))
ge = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=c0["candidate_id"],
    rationale="top-down grasp across the red T crossbar ends with the right arm, to carry it to the blue block's reset spot")
print("grasp red:", ge.status, ge.ok, ge.failure_code)
print("stages", [(s.get("stage"), s.get("status")) for s in ge["result"].get("stages", [])])
if not ge.ok:
    handoff("red grasp failed", ge.status, ge.failure_code, ge["result"].get("stages"))

bl = held_block(current(), "right_wrist", "red", "right")
print("red held:", json.dumps(bl, default=str))
if bl is None:
    handoff("red held not measured")
p0 = np.array(bl["link6"]); T0 = np.array(bl["top_centroid"])
R0 = Rotation.from_quat(np.array(current().robot_facts["end_effectors"]["right"]["pose_xyz_xyzw"][3:]))
o_local = R0.inv().apply(T0 - p0)
d = wrap_deg(refs["blue"]["yaw_deg"] - bl["yaw_deg"])
R1 = Rz(d) * R0
print("o_local", o_local, "delta", d, "held yaw", bl["yaw_deg"], "tilt", bl["tilt_deg"], "dz", bl["dz"])

def mov(p, q, inter="free_space", speed="normal"):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(x) for x in p],
                                          "orientation_mode": "absolute_quaternion",
                                          "orientation_xyzw": [float(x) for x in q], "interaction": inter}},
                        speed=speed)
    print("  move", np.round(p, 4).tolist(), r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
    return r

transit = blue_reset - R1.apply(o_local) + np.array([0, 0, 0.06])
rc = query("reach_check", arm="right", poses=[list(transit) + list(R1.as_quat()),
                                             list(blue_reset - R1.apply(o_local)) + list(R1.as_quat())],
           interaction="precision")
print("reach:", rc.get("results"))
if not all(x.get("reachable") for x in rc["results"]):
    handoff("target unreachable", res=rc.get("results"))
if not mov(transit, R1.as_quat()).ok:
    handoff("transit failed")
bl2 = held_block(current(), "right_wrist", "red", "right")
print("after transit:", json.dumps(bl2, default=str))
json.dump({"red_held": bl, "red_after_transit": bl2, "R1": list(R1.as_quat()), "o_local": o_local.tolist(),
           "blue_reset": blue_reset.tolist(), "delta": d},
          open("/work/state_red_carry.json", "w"), indent=2)

blue_reset = np.array([refs["blue"]["top_centroid_xy"][0], refs["blue"]["top_centroid_xy"][1], 0.7805])
print("start", obs.observation_id, "step", obs.step)

bl = held_block(obs, "right_wrist", "red", "right")
if bl is None:
    handoff("red not seen in wrist view")
p_now = np.array(bl["link6"]); T_now = np.array(bl["top_centroid"])
R_now = Rotation.from_quat(np.array(obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"]["right"]["pose_xyz_xyzw"][3:]))
o_local = R_now.inv().apply(T_now - p_now)
print("held red: yaw", bl["yaw_deg"], "tilt", bl["tilt_deg"], "T", T_now.tolist(), "o_local", o_local)
print("xy error vs goal:", (T_now[:2] - blue_reset[:2]).tolist(), "yaw err", wrap_deg(bl["yaw_deg"] - refs["blue"]["yaw_deg"]))

def mov(p, q, inter="precision", speed="careful"):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": {"position_mode": "absolute", "position_m": [float(x) for x in p],
                                          "orientation_mode": "absolute_quaternion",
                                          "orientation_xyzw": [float(x) for x in q], "interaction": inter}},
                        speed=speed)
    print("  move", np.round(p, 4).tolist(), r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
    return r

desc = blue_reset - R_now.apply(o_local)
print("descend target", desc.tolist())
rc = query("reach_check", arm="right", poses=[list(desc) + list(R_now.as_quat())], interaction="precision")
print("reach:", rc.get("results"))
if not rc["results"][0].get("reachable"):
    handoff("descend unreachable", res=rc.get("results"))
if not mov(desc, R_now.as_quat()).ok:
    handoff("descend failed")
bl2 = held_block(current(), "right_wrist", "red", "right")
print("at descend: top_z", bl2["top_centroid"][2] if bl2 else None, "tilt", bl2["tilt_deg"] if bl2 else None,
      "yaw", bl2["yaw_deg"] if bl2 else None)
zoff = (bl2["top_centroid"][2] if bl2 else 0.7805) - 0.7805
if bl2 is not None and zoff > 0.002:
    p_now = np.array(current().pose("right").position.xyz)
    print("extra descent", zoff - 0.001)
    if not mov(p_now + np.array([0, 0, -(zoff - 0.001)]), R_now.as_quat()).ok:
        handoff("extra descent failed")
    bl2 = held_block(current(), "right_wrist", "red", "right")
    print("after extra: top_z", bl2["top_centroid"][2] if bl2 else None)

r = tools.set_gripper(targets={"right": "open"})

r = tools.move_pose(targets={"right": {"position_mode": "delta", "translation_m": [0.0, 0.0, 0.10],

cur = current()

print("right link6", cur.pose("right").position.xyz.tolist())
fin = {}
for color in ("red", "blue"):
    m = table_block(cur, "head", color)
    print(color, "final:", json.dumps(m, default=str))
    fin[color] = m
res = {}
if fin["red"] and fin["blue"]:
    res["red_pos_err_mm"] = float(np.hypot(fin["red"]["centroid"][0] - blue_reset[0],
                                           fin["red"]["centroid"][1] - blue_reset[1]) * 1000)
    res["red_yaw_err_deg"] = float(wrap_deg(fin["red"]["yaw_deg"] - refs["blue"]["yaw_deg"]))
    res["red_tilt_deg"] = fin["red"]["tilt_deg"]
    res["blue_pos_err_mm"] = float(np.hypot(fin["blue"]["centroid"][0] - red_reset[0],
                                            fin["blue"]["centroid"][1] - red_reset[1]) * 1000)
    res["blue_yaw_err_deg"] = float(wrap_deg(fin["blue"]["yaw_deg"] - refs["red"]["yaw_deg"]))
    res["blue_tilt_deg"] = fin["blue"]["tilt_deg"]
    res["red_top_z"] = fin["red"]["top_z"]
    res["blue_top_z"] = fin["blue"]["top_z"]
print("FINAL ERRORS:", json.dumps(res, indent=2))
json.dump({"final": fin, "errors": res}, open("/work/final_check.json", "w"), indent=2)
